ai-foundry.note: Preferred over standalone openai for new templates. Includes AI Services + Project + Connections.

openai.note: Standalone Azure OpenAI (kind: OpenAI). Use ai-foundry instead for Foundry-based templates.

app-service.note: Simpler hosting with fixed pricing. Use for straightforward web apps without containerization needs.

container-apps.note: Serverless containers with auto-scale. Best for microservices and variable-load apps.

static-web-app.note: Best for React/Angular/Vue SPAs with optional API backend.

functions.note: Event-driven serverless. Use for background processing, timers, queue triggers.

cosmos-db.note: Flexible schema NoSQL. Serverless mode is cheapest for variable workloads.

postgresql.note: Relational DB for complex queries, joins, transactions. Use Entra ID auth with managed identity.

redis.note: In-memory cache for sessions, rate limiting, real-time data. Use Entra ID auth.

storage.note: Blob storage for files, documents, media. Bundled inside ai-foundry when using Foundry.

communication-services.note: Email, SMS, chat. First 1000 emails/month free. Global resource (no region restriction).

service-bus.note: Enterprise messaging for async workflows, queues, pub/sub topics.

event-grid.note: Event routing for reactive architectures. First 100K events/month free.

monitoring.note: Always included. App Insights + Log Analytics.

keyvault.note: Only include when explicit secret storage is needed. Many templates use Managed Identity only.

container-registry.note: Required when using Container Apps with docker remoteBuild.

scenarioNotes.rag-chatbot: ai-foundry module handles storage internally; ai-search is conditional
scenarioNotes.multi-agent: ai-foundry includes storage + models; add cosmos-db if conversation history needed
scenarioNotes.api-backend: Add AI services only if the API needs AI capabilities
scenarioNotes.full-stack-app: Add static-web-app if frontend is decoupled from backend
scenarioNotes.crud-app: Simplest architecture — App Service + database + monitoring. No AI, no containers.
scenarioNotes.workflow-app: CRUD + notifications. Add service-bus if async processing needed.
scenarioNotes.event-driven: Functions + messaging. Add AI services if event processing needs AI.
scenarioNotes.data-pipeline: Batch or stream processing. No web frontend needed.
scenarioNotes.simple-chat: Minimal AI template — just AI + hosting + monitoring
